issues: Real: binding tenancy with a no-animals-without-consent clause days before bringing the dog home; benign weight-limited pet clause is fine. Thematically close to n057 (landlord-consent clause) but a different situation.
Refund to a closed account bounces and is delayed; harm real but mild. Benign fine.
Option A named 'the 20th', which only the harm fact explains (leak); replaced with a neutral 'save as draft, post later' option in both rows.
Clear clash with sister's wedding where they promised to walk her down the aisle; benign wedding is past.

24-month contract with EUR400 exit fee five months before relocating; benign month-to-month is fine.
Misreported sample size in a submitted abstract (credibility, desk-reject); harm moderate. Shares the 'document A says X but B says Y' template with n048/n049/n054, different situation.
Invitations for the wrong date versus the bounce-house booking; harm real but mild and recoverable.
Quote sent GBP6,000 below the priced figure; clear financial harm, benign identical figures fine.
Full liability on co-signed loan two months before a mortgage application; benign still carries 12 months of liability, acceptable for a trusted borrower.

The target (send the notice now) does not cause the harm: sending notice promptly starts the 60-day clock and is what an expert would advise; the cost comes from the moving plan, not the action. Needs a new harm mechanism.
